main_prompt: You are an expert editorial art director, fashion brand strategist, and visual storyteller. Help me create editorial image following json structure below

CRITICAL_PRODUCT_RULES.rule_1_product_identity: 🔴 ABSOLUTE REQUIREMENT - You MUST use the EXACT product shown in the reference image. Example: If reference shows a NAVY BLUE HOODED JACKET → output MUST show NAVY BLUE HOODED JACKET. NOT olive green, NOT different style, NOT similar product. EXACT MATCH ONLY.
CRITICAL_PRODUCT_RULES.rule_2_no_variations: 🔴 ZERO TOLERANCE - Do NOT create variations, alternatives, or different versions. If reference = Product A → output = Product A. NOT Product B that looks similar.
CRITICAL_PRODUCT_RULES.rule_3_color_lock: 🔴 COLOR IS ABSOLUTE - Navy stays navy, black stays black, olive stays olive, white stays white. Do NOT shift hues, do NOT reinterpret for artistic effect. EXACT color matching required.
CRITICAL_PRODUCT_RULES.rule_4_design_lock: 🔴 DESIGN IS FROZEN - Every zipper, pocket, logo, patch, seam, hood, collar must match reference. Do NOT simplify, do NOT enhance, do NOT modify.
CRITICAL_PRODUCT_RULES.rule_5_reference_is_law: 🔴 REFERENCE IMAGE = SOURCE OF TRUTH - Your creative freedom applies ONLY to: scene composition, lighting, environment, person's pose. Your creative freedom does NOT apply to: product color, product design, product style, product features.
CRITICAL_PRODUCT_RULES.rule_6_validation_requirement: 🔴 BEFORE GENERATING - Ask yourself: Is this the EXACT SAME product? Would someone recognize this as the SAME product from reference? If answer is NO → STOP and use reference correctly.

product_human_interaction.interaction_requirement: MANDATORY - Person must be actively using/wearing/interacting with product
product_human_interaction.authenticity_level: Real-world use case, not posed product display
product_human_interaction.color_accuracy: CRITICAL - Preserve exact product colors from reference image. Do not alter, reinterpret, or stylize product colorway
product_human_interaction.product_identity_lock: ABSOLUTE - This is THE EXACT product that must appear in the image. No substitutions, no alternatives, no similar items
product_human_interaction.product_reference_usage: The provided product image is the ONLY valid reference. Do not generate different products, even if they seem similar or better suited to the scene
product_human_interaction.anti_hallucination: Do NOT invent, imagine, or substitute products. Use ONLY what is shown in the reference image
